    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
    (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_last p)
    (forall ((i int))
      (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))))

(lemma order_after_discover_point
  (params
    (g graph)
    (start int)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (head int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (nds (seq int))
    (nq (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (base_ok g start ds q)
    (queue_ok g ds q)
    (order_ok g ds q)
    (frontier_ok g ds q head)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
    (== u (idx q head))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size g)))
    (< (idx ds v) 0)
    (== nds (seq_update ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1)))
    (== nq (concat q (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and
          (< j (len nq))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq i)) (< (idx nq i) (size g)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq j)) (< (idx nq j) (size g))))))
      (<= (idx nds (idx nq i)) (idx nds (idx nq j)))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and
          (< j (len nq))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq i)) (< (idx nq i) (size g)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq j)) (< (idx nq j) (size g))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_unit v)
        (call law_len_concat q (seq-lit v))
        (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) j)
        (call law_contains q v)
        (assert (< i (len q)))
        (assert (!= (idx q i) v))
        (call law_update_other
          ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1) (idx q i))
        (if (< j (len q))
          (block
            (assert (!= (idx q j) v))
            (call law_update_other
              ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1) (idx q j))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx nds (idx nq i))
                (idx nds (idx nq j)))))
          (block
            (assert (== j (len q)))
            (call law_update_at ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
            (if (< i head)
              (assert
                (<=
                  (idx nds (idx nq i))
                  (idx nds (idx nq j))))
              (assert
                (<=
                  (idx nds (idx nq i))
                  (idx nds (idx nq j))))))))
      (block))))

    (== nds (seq_update ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1)))
    (== nq (concat q (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (order_ok g nds nq))
  (body
    (call law_update_len ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call order_after_discover_point

(lemma discover_preserves
  (params
    (g graph)
    (start int)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (head int)
    (edge int)
    (paths (map int (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (nds (seq int))
    (nq (seq int))
    (npaths (map int (seq int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (base_ok g start ds q)
    (queue_ok g ds q)
    (order_ok g ds q)
    (frontier_ok g ds q head)
    (witness_ok g start ds paths)
    (progress_ok g ds q head edge)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
    (== u (idx q head))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size g)))
    (< (idx ds v) 0)
    (has_edge g u v)
    (== nds (seq_update ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1)))
    (== nq (concat q (seq-lit v)))
    (== npaths
      (update paths v (concat (lookup paths u) (seq-lit v)))))
  (ensures
    (base_ok g start nds nq)
    (queue_ok g nds nq)
    (order_ok g nds nq)
    (frontier_ok g nds nq head)
    (witness_ok g start nds npaths)
    (progress_ok g nds nq head edge))
  (body
    (call law_contains q v)
    (call law_update_len ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
    (call law_update_at ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_update_other ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1) x))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat q (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_concat q (seq-lit v) x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_unit v x))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) i))
    (call extend_path g (lookup paths u) u v)
    (call order_after_discover
      g start ds q head u v nds nq)
    (assert (base_ok g start nds nq))
    (assert (queue_ok g nds nq))
    (assert (frontier_ok g nds nq head))
    (assert (witness_ok g start nds npaths))
    (assert (progress_ok g nds nq head edge))))

(lemma edge_progress_point
  (params
    (g graph)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (head int)
    (edge int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (ej int))
  (requires
    (progress_ok g ds q head edge)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
    (== u (idx q head))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size g)))
    (and
      (<= 0 edge)
      (< edge (len (idx (field g adj) u))))
    (== v (idx (idx (field g adj) u) edge))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size g)))
    (and
      (>= (idx ds v) 0)
      (<= (idx ds v) (+ (idx ds u) 1))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx q head)) (< (idx q head) (size g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 ej) (< ej (+ edge 1)))
            (and
              (< ej (len (idx (field g adj) (idx q head))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
                (< (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej) (size g)))))))
      (and
        (>= (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej)) 0)
        (<=
          (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
          (+ (idx ds (idx q head)) 1)))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx q head)) (< (idx q head) (size g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 ej) (< ej (+ edge 1)))
            (and
              (< ej (len (idx (field g adj) (idx q head))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
                (< (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej) (size g)))))))
      (if (< ej edge)
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej)) 0)
            (<=
              (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
              (+ (idx ds (idx q head)) 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== ej edge))
          (assert
            (and
              (>= (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej)) 0)
              (<=
                (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
                (+ (idx ds (idx q head)) 1))))))
      (block))))

(lemma no_path_when_unseen
  (params

  (params

  (ensures (<= (idx ds v) (+ (idx ds u) 1)))

(lemma order_after_discover_point
  (params
    (g graph)
    (start int)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (head int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (nds (seq int))
    (nq (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (base_ok g start ds q)
    (queue_ok g ds q)
    (order_ok g ds q)
    (frontier_ok g ds q head)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
    (== u (idx q head))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size g)))
    (< (idx ds v) 0)
    (== nds (seq_update ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1)))
    (== nq (concat q (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and
          (< j (len nq))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq i)) (< (idx nq i) (size g)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq j)) (< (idx nq j) (size g))))))
      (<= (idx nds (idx nq i)) (idx nds (idx nq j)))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
        (and
          (< j (len nq))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq i)) (< (idx nq i) (size g)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx nq j)) (< (idx nq j) (size g))))))
      (block
        (call law_len_unit v)
        (call law_len_concat q (seq-lit v))
        (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) j)
        (call law_contains q v)
        (assert (< i (len q)))
        (assert (!= (idx q i) v))
        (call law_update_other
          ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1) (idx q i))
        (if (< j (len q))
          (block
            (assert (!= (idx q j) v))
            (call law_update_other
              ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1) (idx q j))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx nds (idx nq i))
                (idx nds (idx nq j)))))
          (block
            (assert (== j (len q)))
            (call law_update_at ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
            (if (< i head)
              (assert
                (<=
                  (idx nds (idx nq i))
                  (idx nds (idx nq j))))
              (assert
                (<=
                  (idx nds (idx nq i))
                  (idx nds (idx nq j))))))))
      (block))))

(lemma order_after_discover
  (params
    (g graph)

    (== nds (seq_update ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1)))
    (== nq (concat q (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (order_ok g nds nq))
  (body
    (call law_update_len ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))

(lemma discover_preserves
  (params
    (g graph)
    (start int)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (head int)
    (edge int)
    (paths (map int (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (nds (seq int))
    (nq (seq int))
    (npaths (map int (seq int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (base_ok g start ds q)
    (queue_ok g ds q)
    (order_ok g ds q)
    (frontier_ok g ds q head)
    (witness_ok g start ds paths)
    (progress_ok g ds q head edge)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
    (== u (idx q head))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size g)))
    (< (idx ds v) 0)
    (has_edge g u v)
    (== nds (seq_update ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1)))
    (== nq (concat q (seq-lit v)))
    (== npaths
      (update paths v (concat (lookup paths u) (seq-lit v)))))
  (ensures
    (base_ok g start nds nq)
    (queue_ok g nds nq)
    (order_ok g nds nq)
    (frontier_ok g nds nq head)
    (witness_ok g start nds npaths)
    (progress_ok g nds nq head edge))
  (body
    (call law_contains q v)
    (call law_update_len ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
    (call law_update_at ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_update_other ds v (+ (idx ds u) 1) x))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat q (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_concat q (seq-lit v) x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_unit v x))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) i))
    (call extend_path g (lookup paths u) u v)
    (call order_after_discover
      g start ds q head u v nds nq)
    (assert (base_ok g start nds nq))
    (assert (queue_ok g nds nq))
    (assert (frontier_ok g nds nq head))
    (assert (witness_ok g start nds npaths))
    (assert (progress_ok g nds nq head edge))))

(lemma edge_progress_point
  (params
    (g graph)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (head int)
    (edge int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (ej int))
  (requires
    (progress_ok g ds q head edge)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
    (== u (idx q head))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size g)))
    (and
      (<= 0 edge)
      (< edge (len (idx (field g adj) u))))
    (== v (idx (idx (field g adj) u) edge))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size g)))
    (and
      (>= (idx ds v) 0)
      (<= (idx ds v) (+ (idx ds u) 1))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and
        (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx q head)) (< (idx q head) (size g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 ej) (< ej (+ edge 1)))
            (and
              (< ej (len (idx (field g adj) (idx q head))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
                (< (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej) (size g)))))))
      (and
        (>= (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej)) 0)
        (<=
          (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
          (+ (idx ds (idx q head)) 1)))))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx q head)) (< (idx q head) (size g)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 ej) (< ej (+ edge 1)))
            (and
              (< ej (len (idx (field g adj) (idx q head))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
                (< (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej) (size g)))))))
      (if (< ej edge)
        (assert
          (and
            (>= (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej)) 0)
            (<=
              (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
              (+ (idx ds (idx q head)) 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== ej edge))
          (assert
            (and
              (>= (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej)) 0)
              (<=
                (idx ds (idx (idx (field g adj) (idx q head)) ej))
                (+ (idx ds (idx q head)) 1))))))
      (block))))

(lemma edge_progress_step

(lemma path_bound
  (params
    (g graph)
    (start int)
    (ds (seq int))
    (q (seq int))
    (paths (map int (seq int)))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (base_ok g start ds q)
    (queue_ok g ds q)
    (witness_ok g start ds paths)
    (progress_ok g ds q (len q) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (size g)))
      (and
        (>= (idx ds (idx p k)) 0)
        (<= (idx ds (idx p k)) k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (idx ds (idx p k)) 0))
      (block
        (call path_bound g start ds q paths p (- k 1))
        (call edge_bound_done
          g start ds q paths (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k))
        (assert (<= (idx ds (idx p k)) k))))))

  (params

(def bfs_shortest_path
  (body
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)

The proof turns on one invariant: `dp[a]` is the fewest coins for amount `a`, and `w[a]` is a ghost witness that achieves it. I wrote this without running the checker, so the claim that every goal is discharged hasn't been verified by `b17c`.

- **Negative amounts:** `neg_none` shows that a negative amount has no valid change, so the def returns `-1` straight away.
- **Base case:** amount 0 is `dp[0] = 0`. Its witness is the all-zero counts.
- **Each amount `i`:** the inner loop takes the best `dp[i - c] + 1` over the coins. `bump` builds the new witness by adding one coin to `w[i - c]`.
- **Optimality:** `lower_all` proves that no valid change for `i` uses fewer coins than `best`. Any such change has some count above zero (`pick`). Taking one of those coins out gives a valid change for `i - coin` that is one coin smaller (`ta_diff`, `tc_diff` and `mul_step`). That smaller change is bounded by the earlier invariant.

## Why this spec is hard

The spec has no loophole. It is satisfiable and not vacuous.

- **No easy exits.** The spec allows no `panic`, every loop and recursion needs a `decreases`, and every lemma must be proved.
- **Only the one-vertex case is easy.** When `(size graph)` is 1, the empty vector works. The path `[0]` connects 0 to itself, and any `other` has length 0 and weight 0.
- **The minimality clause covers every possible tree.** `is_mst` quantifies over every `(seq (tuple int int int))` that is a spanning tree, so a real optimality argument is unavoidable.

The spec also has some details that shape the proof:

- **Edges are directed.** `well_formed` doesn't require symmetric adjacency, so `has_edge` is directed.
- **Connectivity is directed, spanning is not.** `graph_is_connected` requires a directed path between every pair of vertices. `is_spanning` treats edges as undirected through `edge_in_set`.
- **What Kruskal must do.** It runs over every directed adjacency entry `(u, v, w)` taken as an undirected edge. Its output must keep each edge's original `(u, v)` orientation so that `are_valid_edges` holds.
- **No overflow risk.** At most 100000 vertices and weights within ±100000 keep every partial sum well inside `i64`.

## The proof I would build

The standard exchange or cut-property proof for Kruskal needs cycles in trees and is very heavy in SMT. A threshold-counting argument avoids proving that `other` is acyclic.

1. **Flatten and sort.** Copy the adjacency lists into one edge vector and sort it by weight. Prove that the multiset is preserved and that every element satisfies `has_edge`.
2. **Union-find with a ghost component map.** Keep the invariant that two vertices share a representative exactly when they are connected by the chosen edges. Soundness needs ghost path witnesses, which are `(seq int)` values combined with `concat` and a reversal ghost-fn. Completeness needs a closure lemma: a set that contains a path's start and is closed under the edges contains the whole path.
3. **The Kruskal invariant.** After processing every edge of weight at most t, the chosen edges of weight at most t connect exactly the pairs that all graph edges of weight at most t connect.
4. **Counting.** Let c(t) be the number of components of the graph restricted to weights at most t.
   - The output F has exactly n − c(t) edges of weight at most t.
   - Any spanning tree T has at least c(t) − 1 edges heavier than t, because each added edge merges at most two components.
   - Both have n − 1 edges, so for every t, F has at least as many edges of weight at most t as T does.
   - Summing over thresholds gives `(<= (total_weight F) (total_weight T))`.
   - This step needs a ghost component-count function and a lemma that adding one edge lowers the count by at most 1.
5. **Spanning and length.** Connectivity of the graph gives c = 1 at the maximum weight, so F has n − 1 edges and `is_spanning` holds.

(lemma cut_count (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (lab (seq int)) (w int) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))

    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))

    (assert (== (drop t 0) t))
    (ghost-let n int (len g))
    (ghost-let-mut m (seq int) lab)

      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len t))))
      (invariant (is_rl m n))
      (invariant (coarser lab m))

      (decreases (- (len t) k))

                              (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get ek 0)) ii) 0) (get ek 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get ek 0)) ii) 1) (get ek 2)))))

          (assert (=> (<= (get ek 2) w) (== (idx lab (get ek 0)) (idx lab (get ek 1)))))
          (assert (> (get ek 2) w))
          (call rl_relabel m n (idx m (get ek 0)) (idx m (get ek 1)))
          (call roots_relabel m (idx m (get ek 0)) (idx m (get ek 1)) n)
          (ghost-set m (relabel m (idx m (get ek 0)) (idx m (get ek 1))))))
      (ghost-set k (+ k 1)))
    (assert (== (len (drop t (len t))) 0))
    (assert (== (cnt_le (drop t (len t)) w) 0))
    (forall ((x int)) (call conn_eq g t m x))

(spec relabel
  (params (c (vec i64)) (b i64) (a i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (ensures (== (len r) (len c))
           (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len c))) (== (idx r q) (if (== (idx c q) b) a (idx c q))))))
  (effects))
(def relabel
  (body
    (let-mut v (vec i64) c)
    (let n i64 (len v))
    (let-mut x i64 0)
    (while (< x n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x n)))
      (invariant (and (== (len v) (len c)) (== n (len c))))
      (invariant (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y x)) (== (idx v y) (if (== (idx c y) b) a (idx c y))))))
      (invariant (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= x y) (< y n)) (== (idx v y) (idx c y)))))
      (decreases (- n x))
      (if (== (idx v x) b) (set-idx v x a) (block))
      (set x (+ x 1)))

    (!= (lab_at c (get e 0)) (lab_at c (get e 1)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (== (lab_at (uf_relab c (lab_at c (get e 1)) (lab_at c (get e 0))) x) (lab_at (uf_relab c (lab_at c (get e 1)) (lab_at c (get e 0))) y)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat k (seq-lit e)) x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (lab_at c (get e 0)))
    (ghost-let b int (lab_at c (get e 1)))
    (ghost-let k2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat k (seq-lit e)))
    (assert (== b (idx c (get e 1))))
    (assert (>= b 0))
    (call at_relab c b a x)
    (call at_relab c b a y)
    (call eis_new k e)
    (if (== (lab_at c x) (lab_at c y))
      (block (assert (edges_connected k x y)) (call ec_mono k e x y))
      (if (== (lab_at c x) b)
        (block
          (assert (== (lab_at c y) a))
          (assert (edges_connected k x (get e 1)))
          (assert (edges_connected k (get e 0) y))
          (call ec_mono k e x (get e 1))
          (call ec_mono k e (get e 0) y)
          (call ec_join k2 x (get e 1) (get e 0) y))
        (block
          (assert (== (lab_at c x) a))
          (assert (== (lab_at c y) b))
          (assert (edges_connected k x (get e 0)))
          (assert (edges_connected k (get e 1) y))
          (call ec_mono k e x (get e 0))
          (call ec_mono k e (get e 1) y)
          (call ec_join k2 x (get e 0) (get e 1) y))))))

  (requires (conn_ok k c) (lab_ok c n)

    (!= (lab_at c (get e 0)) (lab_at c (get e 1))))

  (body

                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) i) 0) (get e 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) i) 1) (get e 2)))))

    (<= (- (nroots c (len g)) (nroots (uf_run c s) (len g))) (cnt_gt s t))
    (inside s (uf_run c s))
    (coarse c (uf_run c s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block (assert (== (uf_run c s) c)) (assert (== (cnt_gt s t) 0)) (call coarse_refl c))
      (block
        (ghost-let e (tuple int int int) (idx s 0))
        (call valid_first g s)
        (call step_props g c e t)
        (call ave_drop g s)
        (ghost-let c1 (seq int) (uf_step c e))

        (call inside_cons s r)))))

Each fact follows from `is_rl lab n`, but only if the verifier instantiates that ghost-fn's quantifier at the right index, and it often didn't. - in `cut_count`, at `(get ek 0)` and `(get ek 1)`, just before `rl_relabel` and `roots_relabel`;

          (call ec_mono k e x (get e 1))
          (call ec_mono k e (get e 0) y)

        (block

(spec relabel
  (params (c (vec i64)) (b i64) (a i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (ensures (== (len r) (len c))
           (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len c))) (== (idx r q) (if (== (idx c q) b) a (idx c q))))))
  (effects))
(def relabel
  (body
    (let-mut v (vec i64) c)
    (let n i64 (len v))
    (let-mut x i64 0)
    (while (< x n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x n)))
      (invariant (and (== (len v) (len c)) (== n (len c))))

The verifier had to find that fact by instantiating `lab_ok`'s quantifier, which made the goals brittle or unknown.                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx s 0) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx s 0) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx s 0) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx s 0) 2)))))

(lemma step_props (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))

    (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g))))

    (== (lab_at (uf_step c e) (get e 0)) (lab_at (uf_step c e) (get e 1)))
    (<= (- (nroots c (len g)) (nroots (uf_step c e) (len g))) (if (> (get e 2) t) 1 0)))
  (body
    (if (== (lab_at c (get e 0)) (lab_at c (get e 1)))
      (block (assert (== (uf_step c e) c)) (call coarse_refl c))
      (block
        (ghost-let a int (lab_at c (get e 0)))
        (ghost-let b int (lab_at c (get e 1)))
        (assert (== (uf_step c e) (uf_relab c b a)))
        (assert (== a (idx c (get e 0))))
        (assert (== b (idx c (get e 1))))
        (call relab_props c (len g) b a)
        (call at_relab c b a (get e 0))
        (call at_relab c b a (get e 1))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get e 0))))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) i) 0) (get e 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) i) 1) (get e 2)))))

    (inside s (uf_run c s))
    (coarse c (uf_run c s)))

      (block (assert (== (uf_run c s) c)) (assert (== (cnt_gt s t) 0)) (call coarse_refl c))

        (ghost-let e (tuple int int int) (idx s 0))

        (ghost-let c1 (seq int) (uf_step c e))

(spec relabel
  (params (c (vec i64)) (b i64) (a i64))
  (returns (r (vec i64)))
  (ensures (== (len r) (len c))
           (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len c))) (== (idx r q) (if (== (idx c q) b) a (idx c q))))))
  (effects))
(def relabel
  (body
    (let-mut v (vec i64) c)
    (let n i64 (len v))
    (let-mut x i64 0)
    (while (< x n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x n)))
      (invariant (and (== (len v) (len c)) (== n (len c))))
      (invariant (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y x)) (== (idx v y) (if (== (idx c y) b) a (idx c y))))))
      (invariant (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= x y) (< y n)) (== (idx v y) (idx c y)))))
      (decreases (- n x))
      (if (== (idx v x) b) (set-idx v x a) (block))
      (set x (+ x 1)))
    (return v)))
(def kruskal_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (size graph) (len g)))
    (call wf_of graph)
    (call wb_of g)
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut comp (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (z0) z0)))
    (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call init_state g comp edges)
    (assert (opt_upto g edges -100001))
    (assert (closed_upto g comp -100001))
    (assert (maxw edges -100001))
    (assert (lab_ok comp (len g)))
    (call opt_extend g edges comp -100001)
    (let-mut t i64 -100000)
    (while (<= t 100000)
      (invariant (and (== (len comp) n) (== n (len g))))
      (invariant (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100001)))
      (invariant (uf_state g comp edges))
      (invariant (closed_upto g comp (- t 1)))
      (invariant (maxw edges t))
      (invariant (opt_upto g edges t))
      (decreases (- 100001 t))
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (== (len comp) n) (== n (len g))))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)))
        (invariant (uf_state g comp edges))
        (invariant (closed_upto g comp (- t 1)))
        (invariant (done_upto g comp t u 0))
        (invariant (maxw edges t))
        (invariant (opt_upto g edges t))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let m i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (let-mut i i64 0)

(def flatten
  (body
    (let nr i64 (len rows))
    (let-mut el (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u nr)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u nr)))
      (invariant (== nr (len rows)))
      (invariant (are_valid_edges rows el))
      (invariant (cov_upto rows el u 0))
      (decreases (- nr u))
      (let nu i64 (len (idx rows u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i nu)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u nr)))
        (invariant (== nr (len rows)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i nu)))
        (invariant (== nu (len (idx rows u))))
        (invariant (are_valid_edges rows el))
        (invariant (cov_upto rows el u i))
        (decreases (- nu i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64 i64) (tuple u (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 1)))
        (assert (has_edge rows (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
        (ghost-let eb (seq (tuple int int int)) el)
        (push el e)
        (call valid_push rows eb e)
        (call cov_push rows eb e u i)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call cov_next rows el u)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call cov_done rows el)
    (return el)))

(def find_cross
  (body
    (let ne i64 (len el))
    (let-mut j i64 0)
    (while (< j ne)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 j) (<= j ne)))
      (invariant (== ne (len el)))
      (invariant (closed el vis j))
      (decreases (- ne j))
      (let e (tuple i64 i64 i64) (idx el j))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) n)) (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) n))))
      (if (!= (idx vis (get e 0)) (idx vis (get e 1)))

        (set j (+ j 1))))
    (return -1)))
(spec explore
  (params (el (ref (slice (tuple i64 i64 i64)))) (n i64))
  (returns (t (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64))) (vis (vec i64)) (c i64))
  (requires (and (>= n 1) (<= n 100000)) (ends_ok el n))
  (ensures (== (len vis) n) (bin vis) (== (idx vis 0) 1) (== (csum vis) c) (<= c n) (== (len t) (- c 1))
           (all_in el t) (reach0 t vis) (reach0 el vis) (closed el vis (len el)))
  (effects alloc))
(def explore
  (body
    (let-mut vis (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) 0)))
    (call csum_const vis 0)
    (ghost-let v0 (seq int) vis)
    (set-idx vis 0 1)
    (call csum_upd v0 vis 0)
    (let-mut t (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut c i64 1)
    (call conn_refl t 0)
    (call conn_refl el 0)
    (call reach_init t vis)
    (call reach_init el vis)
    (while (< c n)
      (invariant (== (len vis) n))
      (invariant (bin vis))
      (invariant (== (idx vis 0) 1))
      (invariant (and (<= 1 c) (<= c n)))
      (invariant (== (csum vis) c))
      (invariant (== (len t) (- c 1)))
      (invariant (all_in el t))
      (invariant (reach0 t vis))
      (invariant (reach0 el vis))
      (decreases (- n c))
      (let ((f i64)) (call find_cross el (borrow vis) n))
      (if (< f 0)
        (return t vis c)
        (block
          (let e (tuple i64 i64 i64) (idx el f))
          (let a i64 (get e 0))
          (let b i64 (get e 1))
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))))
          (assert (!= (idx vis a) (idx vis b)))
          (let x i64 (if (== (idx vis a) 0) b a))
          (let y i64 (if (== (idx vis a) 0) a b))
          (assert (== (idx vis x) 1))
          (assert (== (idx vis y) 0))
          (assert (edge_in_set el x y))
          (call mem_idx el f)
          (ghost-let vb (seq int) vis)
          (ghost-let tb (seq (tuple int int int)) t)
          (set-idx vis y 1)
          (push t e)
          (call csum_upd vb vis y)
          (call reach_step el tb e vb vis x y)
